'''Tamás F. Freund''' (born June 14, 1959 in [[Zirc]]) is a Hungarian neurobiologist. He is president of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] and won the 2011 [[The Brain Prize|Brain Prize]] for research on the functional organization of [[Neural circuit|neuronal circuits]] in the [[cerebral cortex]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Tamás Freund |url=https://www.interacademies.org/person/tamas-freund |access-date=2023-10-23 |website=The Interacademy Partnership |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=The Brain Prize 2011 |url=https://www.fens.org/news-activities/news/the-brain-prize-2011 |access-date=2023-10-23 |website=[[Federation of European Neuroscience Societies]] |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Brain Prize">{{Cite web |title=Tamás Freund |url=https://lundbeckfonden.com/en/tamas-freund |access-date=2023-10-23 |website=The Lundbeck Foundation |language=en}}</ref> He also won the [[Széchenyi Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-10-08 |title=Head of Science Academy: “Katalin Karikó Will Have a Much Better Chance of Winning the Nobel Prize in a Year or Two” |url=https://hungarytoday.hu/head-of-science-academy-katalin-kariko-nobel-prize/ |access-date=2024-01-20 |website=Hungary Today |language=en}}</ref>

Freund attended [[Eötvös Loránd University]], where he received a diploma in biology in 1983 and a [[Doctor of Philosophy]] in neuroscience in 1992.<ref name=":1" /> He later received his [[Doctor of Science]] from the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Brain Prize"/>

Freund was also president of the [[Federation of European Neuroscience Societies]] from 2004 to 2006.<ref name=":0" /> As of 2011, he was director of the [[Institute of Experimental Medicine, Academy of Sciences of the Czech Republic|Institute of Experimental Medicine]] of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]],<ref name=":0" /> as well as the Head of the Department of Neurosciences at [[Pázmány Péter Catholic University]].<ref name="Brain Prize" /> In 2014, he became the president of the National Brain Research Program.<ref name=":1" /> He was re-elected as the president of the Hungarian Academy of Science in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-15 |title=Tamás Freund Re-elected Head of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences |url=https://hungarytoday.hu/tamas-freund-re-elected-head-of-the-hungarian-academy-of-sciences/ |access-date=2024-01-20 |website=Hungary Today |language=en}}</ref>
